title: Venezuelan Chorizo Skillet
description: A spicy and flavorful Venezuelan-inspired dish featuring chorizo sausage, onions, and bell peppers, all cooked to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they begin to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the chorizo mixture hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve with rice, beans, or arepas for a more traditional Venezuelan meal.
